classification: paper-facing exploratory higher-order extension; not the paper-identical random-four-qubit objective

instance_family.objective_description: 6150 frozen uniformly sampled weighted selected-pair interactions, each spanning three distinct blocks
instance_family.qubit_hamiltonian_description: diagonal Hamiltonian with locality up to six
instance_family.weight_distribution: independent Uniform[-0.5, 0.5] after frozen support sampling
instance_family.generator: all conflict-feasible active three-block selected-pair supports, sorted canonically, then deterministically shuffled and truncated

pilot.role: two-seed multi-depth promotion gate; seed 900 was the target-blind calibration instance and both seeds appeared in prior exploratory sparse-depth runs

confirmation.role: six fresh frozen confirmation instances, launched only if the pilot gate passes

stages.history_rule: For each standalone method/configuration, optimize p=20 first; initialize p=26 from p=20 and every later depth from the immediately preceding optimized depth. The transferred solution occupies one restart and the remaining restarts remain independent.

ordinary_selected.calibration: selected after the completed c=0.1 through c=0.0001 target-blind boundary audit

ordinary_initial_calibration.calibration: initial target-blind calibration retained as a direct-favorable sensitivity arm

separated_initial_calibration.calibration: initial target-blind calibration retained as a direct-favorable sensitivity arm

same_state_warm_initial_calibration.calibration: initial target-blind calibration retained as a warm-control sensitivity arm

angle_transfer_control.name: same_state_warm_lp_angle_assisted
angle_transfer_control.initial_state: exact same frozen Stage-1 output state used by learned-projector QAOA
angle_transfer_control.per_depth_rule: At each reported depth, initialize exactly one of five Warm-XY restarts with the optimized learned-projector angles from the same seed and same depth; keep four independent Warm-XY restarts.
angle_transfer_control.interpretation: mechanistic LP-assisted transfer control, not a standalone direct baseline because obtaining its angle initializer requires the learned-projector run

decoupled_control_interpretation.implementation: independently optimized phase angles for the conflict Hamiltonian and the final objective at every layer
decoupled_control_interpretation.strength: strictly more flexible than fixing a single medium conflict/objective phase ratio

primary_metric.name: integer RTS99 multiplied by terminal resource units
includes: Stage-1 preparation for learned-projector and same-state warm methods
primary_metric.optimizer_objective_query_count: reported separately and never substituted for the primary metric

pilot_gate.automatic_confirmation_rule: Launch the six fresh confirmation seeds if every correctness requirement and every standalone-native-direct requirement passes for both targets.
pilot_gate.warm_control_result: always report separately; it diagnoses the contribution of the learned-projector mixer but does not alter the preregistered native-direct promotion gate
pilot_gate.angle_transfer_result: always report separately as a dependent mechanistic control and never count it as a standalone baseline

followup_controls.low_dimensional_standard_qaoa: run on the smallest compatible same-family instance under a separate pre-outcome contract
followup_controls.true_rqaoa: run recursive variable elimination on that same low-dimensional instance under the same separate contract
